title: 1RB1RE_1RC0RF_0LD---_1LE1LD_1RA0LB_0RE1LC: accelerator bug fixed; bounds corrected to 4.11·10<sup>12</sup> (plain) and 7.49·10<sup>12</sup> (accelerated)
text: A bug in the accelerator's 64-cell chunk step made the earlier run go wrong at about 2.13·10<sup>12</sup> steps; its bounds of 6.3·10<sup>12</sup> and 1.9·10<sup>13</sup>, and a halt it reported at 6.38·10<sup>13</sup>, are withdrawn. The fixed accelerator finds no halt in 7.49·10<sup>12</sup> steps, and a plain simulation cut into 14 checked pieces finds none in 4.11·10<sup>12</sup>.
